teaser: AgentiCCells: a new company that sets up small agentic teams in the customer's environment, with a control centre, all open, no state on our side.
core_idea: AgentiCCells, started on 15 November 2026, sets up small agentic teams (cells) in the customer's own environment with a control centre, releases everything open (code open source, the rest Creative Commons) and keeps no state. Perplexity research mapped 30+ vendors and found the gap: nobody packages conductors of conductors, Agent Behaviour Policies and a control centre as an open service. The newsroom review kept the positioning and flagged pricing, commissions, console location and the RiskMandate split. Three domains, Route 53, a repository and a bootstrap brief for its first agentic team followed the same day.
